question: Does a $65 order qualify for free shipping?
query: free shipping threshold minimum order amount shipping policy eligibility $65 order
answer: Yes. The release notes say the free standard shipping threshold is now $60, down from $75 [2][5], so a $65 order qualifies. The FAQ and shipping page still say $75 [1][3], but the release notes are the more recent source, so I went with them. The threshold applies to the subtotal before shipping and tax [5].

Passages:

[1] faq.md > Is shipping free?
### Is shipping free?

Standard shipping is free on orders of $75 or more. Below that, standard shipping is a flat $6.95.
Expedited shipping is $14.95 and overnight is $29.95 on any order size.

[2] release-notes.md > Changes
### Changes

- Free shipping threshold: $60 (was $75). The old threshold was in place since the store
  launched; this is the first change to it.
- Gift card purchase, delivery and redemption, online and in-store.
- Points preview and reward redemption at checkout for signed-in Lumen Rewards members.
- The order confirmation email now lists the delivery estimate as a date range rather than
  "3–6 business days".
- Signature-required orders (over $400) now say so on the checkout page, not only in the
  confirmation email.

[3] shipping.md > Rates and delivery times
| Service   | Cost                             | Delivery time         | Same-day cutoff |
|-----------|----------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| Standard  | $6.95, free on orders of $75 or more | 3 to 6 business days | 2:00 PM ET    |
| Expedited | $14.95                           | 2 business days       | 2:00 PM ET      |
| Overnight | $29.95                           | Next business day     | 1:00 PM ET      |
| Canada    | $19.95 flat                      | 5 to 10 business days | 2:00 PM ET      |

Standard shipping is free on orders with a merchandise subtotal of $75 or more, calculated after
discounts and before tax. Fuel and oversized items count toward the subtotal. Orders under $75
pay the flat $6.95. Expedited and overnight are never free, though Flame and Beacon tier Lumen
Rewards members receive free upgrades from standard to expedited under the terms of that program.

Overnight service is available only to addresses in the contiguous 48 states and only for orders
placed by 1:00 PM ET on a business day. An overnight order placed on a Friday before the cutoff is
delivered on Monday.

[4] shipping.md > Signature on delivery
### Signature on delivery

Orders over $400 ship with a signature required. The threshold is applied to the merchandise
subtotal. Customers who cannot be present may redirect the package to a UPS Access Point through
the carrier's tracking page. The warehouse does not waive the signature requirement on request.

[5] release-notes.md > Highlights
### Highlights

Free standard shipping now starts at $60, down from $75. The threshold is applied to the order
subtotal before shipping and tax, the same way the $75 threshold was. The shipping page and the
cart both show the new amount, and the cart shows how much more a customer needs to add to
qualify. We expect the change to move a good share of the $60–$75 orders that used to stall at
the cart.

Gift cards are on sale for the first time. They come in $25, $50, $100 and $200 amounts, are
delivered by email within an hour of purchase, and can be redeemed online or at either
showroom. Gift cards are final sale and do not earn Lumen Rewards points when bought, though
purchases paid with them do.

Lumen Rewards points now appear at checkout. A member sees the points the order will earn next
to the order total, and any reward they have available is offered as a payment line before the
card step.
